title: World Bloom — Break Down the Wall — Episode4 Together, Whatever It Takes

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD continue their intensive training, set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND. But one day in the Street SEKAI, a new area suddenly appears: an unfamiliar plaza, in which stands a huge wall...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, this one looks really pretty!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
I'm reminded of the streets in Hamburg.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did your dad also do a concert there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, a number of times.
However, this feels more downtown than the streets I walked on then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Look at all the flyers on the walls!
They're so fun and colorful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
Their designs are interesting and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a flyer for Gurney flap...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that's the name of Tono and Soma's team...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what's their flyer doing here in SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (On closer inspection, it seems only their team name is written here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (There's no information regarding when or where it is, or who else is performing. Not only that, it's starting to fall off.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “What if Soma stops making new songs for him...?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This may be a product of those thoughts.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's true that anxieties like that could also manifest themselves here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When I visited Soma in the hospital after Tono disappeared...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was worried that I'd never see Tono sing Soma's songs again.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A little while back, KAITO, you told me that we share some similarities with Soma and Tono...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You said you saw similarities in how he cares about his partner very much and seems very serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, Arata, let me ask you this. Who are you really singing for?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're not trying to make Soma's dreams come true. You can't face the pain of having lost him, so you're just clinging to his dreams.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I've been thinking about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Tono may be singing because he can't face that pain.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... I'm certain there's more to it than just that. There must be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He cares about the dream that Soma shared with him more deeply than anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as Akito shared his dream with me, which I now care deeply about.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just watching the two of them talking made that...painfully clear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I'm going to complete the task Ken gave me and tell Tono and the others about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In order to get them to return.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, this is wonderful! I'm starting to get all fired up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, this flyer specifically appeared in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that it doesn't come from a place of worry. I think it comes from your desire to surpass RAD WEEKEND with Tono and the others.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Thank you for saying that, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... I noticed that there's a strange flyer posted on the wall behind you, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A strange flyer?
Huh...? No, this is...something else.
